The Bank Board discusses monetary issues eight times a year, and, in exceptional cases, it may also take decisions on monetary issues at extraordinary meetings. The Bank Board’s monetary policy decision is published after the end of monetary policy meeting, at 2:30 p.m. This is followed by a press conference, at 3:00 p. m., at which the CNB releases the statement of the Bank Board containing the ratio of the votes cast about the interest rate settings. The statement also contains the reasons behind the Bank Board decision, including the risks pertaining to the current forecast according to the Bank Board.
